Favorites and navigation

Navigation interaction sample: synthetic permission menu, no business backend

Groups and apps start collapsed. Use the keyboard or mouse to expand/collapse them. Search group, app or model names and reload to check saved state. On phones, open Navigation; Escape clears a search, then closes the menu on the next press. Every menu destination is a local page anchor and performs no admin action.

Collapse preferences stay in this browser’s localStorage; the filter stays in this tab’s sessionStorage. This sample executes two verified navigation scripts only. It has no login, form submission or business API calls. App/model names are supplied by the example host project, not translated by the theme.

Local interactions only

Rendered from real Django 6.1.1 templates and a synthetic in-memory database. This is a static navigation fixture, not a running Django admin service.
